title: Grounding LLM Agents in Business Processes: Process-Aware Knowledge Graphs for Reliable Multi-Step Service Invocation
title_zh: 将大语言模型智能体扎根于业务流程：用于可靠多步服务调用的流程感知知识图谱

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM) agents that call enterprise APIs must select the correct endpoints, follow process order, use valid payload keys, and choose coded values from predefined lists. However, current retrieval-augmented service discovery treats endpoints independently and therefore misses process and schema constraints. We address this limitation by integrating Open Data Protocol (OData) metadata and Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) reference processes in a typed property graph. A hybrid retriever identifies candidate endpoints using dense embeddings and follows process edges to retrieve subsequent endpoints. We evaluate the method on 42 enterprise services with process-chain ground truth. For queries with low lexical overlap between the query and downstream entities, it improves Recall@3 by 5.7 points ( n = 74 n=74 ), with consistent gains across embedding models and cut-offs. It matches dense retrieval on other queries and provides no improvement on OpenAPI services without a process layer, indicating that the gains arise from process structure. We also evaluate an LLM agent on 81 multi-step queries. It completes 38.7% of tasks, compared with 10.3% for a chunk-based baseline. In an elicitation probe, providing valid code lists eliminates invented codes but leaves invalid keys in 46% of write runs. Full typed context reduces invalid calls to 3% (3 of 101 runs), with no invented codes. These results show that exposing process and schema constraints during retrieval improves the reliability of agent-driven API calls.
paragraphs.zh: 调用企业 API 的大语言模型（LLM）智能体必须选择正确的端点、遵循流程顺序、使用有效的载荷键，并从预定义列表中选择编码值。 然而，当前的检索增强服务发现将端点独立处理，因此遗漏了流程和模式约束。 我们通过将开放数据协议（OData）元数据和业务流程模型与标记法（BPMN）参考流程整合到一个类型化属性图中来解决这一局限。 一个混合检索器使用稠密嵌入识别候选端点，并沿流程边检索后续端点。 我们在 42 个具有流程链真值的企业服务上评估了该方法。 对于查询与下游实体之间词汇重叠较低的问题，该方法将 Recall@3 提升了 5.7 个百分点（n=74），并且在不同的嵌入模型和截断设置下均有一致的提升。 该方法在其他查询上与稠密检索持平，而在没有流程层的 OpenAPI 服务上没有提升，这表明提升来自流程结构。 我们还在 81 个多步骤查询上评估了一个 LLM 智能体。 它完成了 38.7% 的任务，而基于分块的基线为 10.3%。 在一项探针实验中，提供有效的编码列表消除了臆造的编码，但在 46% 的写运行中仍存在无效的键。 完整的类型化上下文将无效调用降至 3%（101 次运行中的 3 次），且没有臆造的编码。 这些结果表明，在检索过程中暴露流程和模式约束能够提高智能体驱动的 API 调用的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Imagine an AI assistant that must arrange a business trip. It has to find a flight, book it, and then reserve a hotel using the booking reference, in that order. Each booking form also has required fields and fixed code lists, such as cabin class or fare type. The assistant can pick the right booking API and still fail: it may invent a fare code, leave out a required reference, or book the hotel before the flight. Such a call fails just as badly as a call to the wrong API. Reliable multi-step automation therefore needs more than the right endpoint. It also needs two kinds of constraints around each call: sequential constraints (what comes next) and parametric constraints (which keys and code values are valid).
paragraphs.zh: 想象一个必须安排商务出差的 AI 助手。 它需要先找到航班并预订，然后使用预订参考号去预订酒店，顺序不能颠倒。 每张预订表单还有必填字段和固定的代码列表，例如舱位等级或票价类型。 智能体可能选对了预订 API 却仍然失败：它可能编造一个票价代码，遗漏某个必填的参考号，或者在预订航班之前就先订了酒店。 这样的调用失败得和调用错误 API 一样严重。 因此，可靠的多步骤自动化所需的不只是正确的端点。 它还需要围绕每次调用的两类约束：顺序约束（接下来做什么）和参数约束（哪些键和代码值是有效的）。

paragraphs.en: Enterprise software has the same problem at a much larger scale. Large companies expose thousands of APIs. A typical SAP S/4HANA system, for example, ships hundreds of Open Data Protocol (OData) services, each with many collections, fields, and cross-references. Suppose a developer asks: “create a purchase order for supplier X with a valid status code, then confirm goods receipt.” Choosing the right endpoint is only the first step. The payload keys must match the schema, the coded values must be valid, and the calls must follow the business process. Each of these rules gives a language model a chance to produce a call that looks right but is invalid.
paragraphs.zh: 企业软件在更大的规模上存在同样的问题。 大型企业会暴露数千个 API。 例如，一个典型的 SAP S/4HANA 系统自带数百个开放数据协议（OData）服务，每个服务都包含许多集合、字段和交叉引用。 假设一位智能体开发者提出请求：“为供应商 X 创建一张具有有效状态代码的采购订单，然后确认收货。”选择正确的端点只是第一步。 载荷的键必须与架构匹配，编码值必须有效，并且调用必须遵循业务流程。 这些规则中的每一条都可能让语言模型生成一个看起来正确但实际上无效的调用。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on retrieval-augmented service discovery Pesl et al. (2026) ; Song et al. (2023) improves endpoint retrieval with chunking and embedding-based filtering. However, it treats each endpoint as an isolated unit. It leaves out three kinds of context: (a) process , what comes next in the workflow; (b) structure , which entities and value-help codes are valid; and (c) execution , how an agent builds and sends the call. The Discovery Agent Pesl et al. (2026) , for example, ranks endpoints but stops at retrieval, and it has no process-chain ground truth. Its authors suggest knowledge graphs as a way to improve accuracy, but note that graphs are costly to build. We address this gap.

paragraphs.en: Our approach links two open, machine-readable standards. OData $metadata describes the entity collections, fields, and references of a service, but not the order in which they are used. BPMN describes the order of business tasks, but not the data each task uses. We load both sources into one typed property graph and link process activities to the entity sets they use. A hybrid retriever finds the closest entity sets by embedding similarity and then follows process edges to the ones that come next. It returns each endpoint with its schema context, which an execution agent uses to issue validated GET and POST calls through a mock HTTP layer.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法将两个开放且机器可读的标准关联起来。 OData $metadata 描述了服务的实体集合、字段和引用，但并未描述它们的使用顺序。 BPMN 描述了业务任务的执行顺序，但并未描述每个任务所使用的数据。 我们将两个来源加载到一个带类型的属性图中，并将流程活动与其所使用的实体集合关联起来。 一个混合检索器先通过嵌入相似度找到最接近的实体集合，然后沿着流程边找到接下来要使用的实体集合。 它返回每个端点及其模式上下文，执行智能体据此通过模拟 HTTP 层发出经过验证的 GET 和 POST 调用。

paragraphs.en: Enterprise systems and SAP. Companies run their core business tasks, such as purchasing, sales, and warehousing, in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software. SAP S/4HANA is one such ERP system. It gives other programs access to its data through web services, also called APIs. SAP publishes the descriptions of these services in a public catalogue, the SAP Business Accelerator Hub. We use only these public descriptions, so no running SAP system is needed.

paragraphs.en: OData services. The Open Data Protocol (OData) 1 1 1 OASIS OData Version 4.0, https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata/v4.0/odata-v4.0-part1-protocol.html is a standard for web services that read and write data over HTTP. Each OData service publishes a machine-readable description of itself, called its $metadata document. An EntitySet is a named collection of business records, similar to a database table, for example PurchaseOrder . Its EntityType defines the structure of a record, and each field of a record is a Property , for example Supplier . A NavigationProperty links one EntitySet to another and states the cardinality: one purchase order has many purchase-order items (1:N). Some properties accept only codes from a fixed list, which SAP calls value help . For example, the purchase-order type must be NB (standard order), UB (stock transport order), or FO (framework order). A client reads records with a GET call. It creates a record with a POST call, whose body (the payload ) holds the property values. The $metadata document says what data exists, but not in which order a business uses it.

paragraphs.en: BPMN processes. Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN 2.0) 2 2 2 OMG Business Process Model and Notation 2.0, https://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/2.0/ is a standard for describing business processes. A BPMN model is a flow chart of activities (tasks) connected by sequence flows . It is stored as XML, so programs can read it. A purchasing process, for example, may run create purchase order , then post goods receipt , then enter supplier invoice . A BPMN model says in which order tasks happen, but not which data each task uses. Our method links the two standards: each activity is connected to the EntitySets it reads or writes.

paragraphs.en: In service computing Khan et al. (2022) ; Khan et al. (2025) , automated service composition is decades older than LLMs. Semantic web service frameworks such as OWL-S Martin et al. (2007) , WSMO Roman et al. (2005) , and SAWSDL Kopecký et al. (2007) describe service capabilities in machine-readable form. They need a lot of manual modeling, and this cost is one reason given Pesl et al. (2026) for preferring chunk-RAG over knowledge graphs. Other work treats composition as AI planning. HTN planners such as SHOP2 Sirin et al. (2004) turn goals into executable service chains; see Rao and Su (2005) for a survey. QoS-aware methods Zeng et al. (2004) optimize non-functional constraints. Recent non-LLM methods learn service representations directly, for example with feature mining and contrastive learning Xu et al. (2026) . Our process edges look like the workflow skeletons that planners use. The difference is that we derive them from BPMN reference processes and give them to an LLM as retrieval context, not to a symbolic planner.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 1 (right) shows the graph schema. Eight node labels represent OData and BPMN structure, and nine edge types connect them. Two design choices matter for execution. First, we store cardinality on Navigation nodes. This keeps graph queries simple and shows the agent which relations are 1:N and which are N:1. paragraphs.en: Hybrid retrieval. The retriever has two branches. The dense branch runs a top- k k search over the EntitySet summaries and returns a set S S of likely matches. For each e ∈ S e\in S , the process branch runs a bounded graph query that finds downstream EntitySets: it goes from e e to the activities that use it, follows HAS_NEXT to later activities, and collects the EntitySets those activities use. The retriever keeps the dense order, places each new entity after its seed, and removes duplicates. It also returns the cardinality of each navigation, so the agent knows how to shape the payload.
paragraphs.zh: 混合检索。 检索器有两个分支。 稠密分支在 EntitySet 摘要上执行 top- k k 检索，返回可能匹配的集合 S S。 对于每个 e ∈ S e\in S，流程分支运行有界的图查询来查找下游的 EntitySet：它从 e e 出发找到使用它的活动，沿 HAS_NEXT 走到后续活动，并收集这些活动所使用的 EntitySet。 检索器保持稠密顺序，将每个新实体放在其种子之后，并去除重复项。 它还返回每次导航的基数，因此智能体知道如何构造负载。

paragraphs.en: Execution agent. A ReAct agent, built with LangGraph 6 6 6 https://langchain-ai.github.io/langgraph/ , has three tools: (a) hybrid retrieval, which returns the full typed specification (required keys, navigation cardinalities, value-help lists, and process-chain information); (b) GET; and (c) POST. A mock HTTP layer validates every call. All grounding context arrives in one retrieval call, which keeps tool round-trips low for local 30B models. Two mechanisms reduce hallucination. First, POST rejects payloads with missing keys or invalid codes, so the agent can retry. Second, navigation cardinalities tell the agent to send 1:N relations as nested arrays. Fig. 2 shows both mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: Worked example. Consider the query: “Create a purchase order with a valid type code for supplier 4711, then post the goods receipt.” A semantic retriever over endpoint summaries finds PurchaseOrder , but it may miss PurchaseOrderItem because the query never says “item”. The valid type codes exist only in ValueHelp, so an LLM that sees only summaries may output a plausible but invalid code such as NORMAL . It also does not know that MaterialDocumentHeader must follow PurchaseOrder . Fig. 2 shows how our system closes each gap: the dense seed finds PurchaseOrder , process expansion adds MaterialDocumentHeader , and the retrieved specification gives the 1:N item navigation and the value-help list.
paragraphs.zh: 实例演示。 考虑这样一个查询："为供应商 4711 创建一张具有有效类型代码的采购订单，然后过账收货。" 基于端点摘要的语义检索器会找到 PurchaseOrder，但可能会漏掉 PurchaseOrderItem，因为查询中从未提到"item（项目）"。 有效的类型代码只存在于 ValueHelp 中，因此只看到摘要的 LLM 可能会输出一个看似合理但无效的代码，例如 NORMAL。 它也不知道 MaterialDocumentHeader 必须跟在 PurchaseOrder 之后。 图 2 展示了我们的系统如何弥补每一个缺口：稠密种子检索找到 PurchaseOrder，流程扩展加入 MaterialDocumentHeader，而检索到的规范则提供了 1:N 的项目导航和价值帮助列表。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach with a construction-fidelity audit and five research questions (RQs). Each one targets a contribution from Sec. 1 .

paragraphs.en: RQ1 (retrieval quality; contribution (b)): Does process-aware hybrid retrieval find more correct endpoints than dense-only and graph-only retrieval? RQ1 uses each benchmark query word for word, so it measures retrieval without any agent behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: RQ1（检索质量；贡献 (b)）：流程感知的混合检索是否比仅稠密检索和仅图检索找到更多正确的端点？ RQ1 逐字使用每个基准测试查询，因此它衡量的是不涉及任何智能体行为的检索。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 (end-to-end agent; contribution (c)): Can the agent complete multi-step tasks without invalid calls? RQ3 measures the full loop, so retrieval errors and execution errors are mixed. An oracle-retrieval test separates them.

paragraphs.en: RQ4 (hallucination elicitation; contribution (c)): Does value-help grounding stop invented codes and keys when a query needs a fixed-value code?

paragraphs.en: Our main benchmark, OData-Proc , combines four public OData corpora (SAP Business Accelerator Hub, TripPin, Northwind, and Microsoft Graph) with 14 BPMN reference processes (Table 2 ). It uses only openly published metadata, so no access to a proprietary system is needed. Eight of the process files cover SAP reference scenarios such as Warehouse Inbound Processing and Sell from Stock. We converted these files to BPMN 2.0 from an earlier RDF format and kept the activity names, order, and entity-set mappings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主基准 OData-Proc 将四个公开的 OData 语料库（SAP Business Accelerator Hub、TripPin、Northwind 和 Microsoft Graph）与 14 个 BPMN 参考流程（表 2）相结合。 它仅使用公开发布的元数据，因此无需访问专有系统。 其中八个流程文件涵盖 SAP 参考场景，例如仓库入库处理（Warehouse Inbound Processing）和现货销售（Sell from Stock）。 我们将这些文件从较早的 RDF 格式转换为 BPMN 2.0，并保留了活动名称、顺序以及实体集映射。

paragraphs.en: There are five query types. A single-entity query asks for one EntitySet. A navigation-chain query needs EntitySets linked by navigation. A process-chain goal states a business goal whose downstream EntitySets share few words with the query. A multi-step workflow asks for several explicit steps, and a value-help dependent query needs a fixed code. The benchmark has 288 288 queries, split deterministically into 150 150 training and 138 138 test queries. We used the training set only to tune prompt wording and the retriever settings, and did not look at the test set until the final evaluation. All 74 74 process-chain probes are in the test split. The value-help category has only 2 2 queries on purpose: we test code grounding on a separate 56 56 -query elicitation probe with adversarial wording, so that it does not inflate the main retrieval scores. The RQ3 execution experiments use the 81 81 test queries of the four multi-step types that target the SAP corpus. A mock HTTP layer validates payloads against the OData metadata, so the experiments need no live backend. For external generalization, we sample 110 SOCBench-D queries, 10 from each GICS sector Pesl et al. (2026) .

paragraphs.en: The first version of the benchmark had 80 80 queries labelled by one annotator. We grew it by generating 251 251 candidate queries from the catalogue and the process graph, each with machine-suggested labels, and having two annotators review every candidate independently: a human author and a large language model (Claude, Anthropic), whose per-candidate decisions we release. They agreed on whether to keep 250 250 of the 251 251 candidates (Cohen’s κ = 0.665 \kappa=0.665 ) and on all 415 415 (query, EntitySet) labels of the candidates both kept ( κ = 1.000 \kappa=1.000 ). Both saw the suggested labels, so this measures agreement on corrections, not independent labelling. The merge added 208 208 queries to the main benchmark and 41 41 to the elicitation probe (full protocol in Supplementary Sec. S2).
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试的第一版包含由一位标注者标注的 80 80 个查询。 我们通过从目录和流程图中生成 251 251 个候选查询（每个查询都带有机器建议的标签），并由两名标注者——一名人类作者和一个大型语言模型（Claude，Anthropic）——独立审查每个候选查询来扩充基准，我们发布了该模型对每个候选查询的判定结果。 在是否保留 251 251 个候选查询中的 250 250 个这一问题上，二者意见一致（Cohen's κ = 0.665 \kappa=0.665），并且对二者均保留的候选查询的全部 415 415 个（查询，EntitySet）标签也意见一致（κ = 1.000 \kappa=1.000）。 二者都看到了建议的标签，因此这衡量的是对修正的一致性，而非独立标注的一致性。 此次合并为主基准增加了 208 208 个查询，为引导探针增加了 41 41 个查询（完整协议见补充材料第 S2 节）。

paragraphs.en: As expected, the gain appears only where there is a process signal. On the process-chain probe ( n = 74 n=74 ), the downstream entities share few words with the query. Here Hybrid improves Recall@3 by + 5.7 +5.7 points over Dense ( 0.732 0.732 vs. 0.675 0.675 ; p = 0.037 p=0.037 ). The gap narrows to + 3.4 +3.4 points at k = 5 k=5 ( p = 0.13 p=0.13 ) as dense retrieval catches up, and widens again at k = 10 k=10 ( + 3.2 +3.2 points, p = 0.018 p=0.018 ). On the 64 64 non-probe queries, Hybrid stays close to Dense (Recall@3 0.901 0.901 vs. 0.917 0.917 ). The small loss comes from expansion sometimes pushing out a correct dense result. Over the full test split, Hybrid gains + 2.3 +2.3 points at k = 3 k=3 ( 0.810 0.810 vs. 0.787 0.787 ; overall test p = 1.7 × 10 − 31 p=1.7\times 10^{-31} , n = 138 n=138 ). This gain comes entirely from the probe, which makes up more than half of the test split. The effect is smaller than in the earlier 80-query version of the benchmark ( + 15.0 +15.0 probe Recall@3 points on n = 20 n=20 ). Many of the new probe queries were reworded to name their business process explicitly, which gives dense retrieval more words to match.

paragraphs.en: Validity and scope. (i) Construction. The ground-truth chains of the probe come from the hand-written mapping, and the queries are written to avoid word overlap. This favours Hybrid by design. The probe therefore tests whether curated process edges make otherwise unreachable entities retrievable, not whether such edges exist by default. (ii) Multiple comparisons. The overall test is clear ( p = 1.7 × 10 − 31 p=1.7\times 10^{-31} ). We ran two paired tests on the probe, so a stricter threshold of 0.025 0.025 applies to each (Holm correction); the main probe result ( p = 0.037 p=0.037 ) does not meet it. With the smaller mpnet embedding, Hybrid still beats Dense on the probe at every k k , but none of these differences is significant (all p ≥ 0.19 p\geq 0.19 ). We therefore read the probe-level gain as consistent in direction but not confirmed at its current effect size. (iii) Baseline choice. Dense already implements Pesl’s “summary” chunking at the EntitySet level, so it stands in for chunk-RAG on OData. Porting their token-overlap retriever to OData would risk measuring the port, so we evaluate it on its native benchmark, SOCBench-D (RQ5).

paragraphs.en: Scope and circularity. These experiments use no live backend. The mock validator checks payloads against the same metadata and ValueHelp nodes that we used to build the graph, so our agent makes an invalid call only when it ignores or misuses the retrieved context. The invalid-call metric therefore tests whether grounding closes this failure mode by construction, not how the agent performs against a live service (Sec. 6.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Table 5 shows the result. Because the conditions issue POSTs at different rates, we report invalid-call rates over runs that issue a POST. ChunkRAG makes an invalid call in 100 100 of 127 127 POST runs ( 0.79 0.79 , 95% CI [ 0.71 , 0.85 ] [0.71,0.85] ), with 218 218 invalid calls in total. Sixty of these are invented codes, such as DA or EX WORKS instead of the Incoterms codes DAP and EXW , RET instead of the returns code RE , and IV instead of the invoice code F2 . The most common invented code is the purchasing code NB reused as a sales-order type ( 19 19 times), so pre-training is not reliable even for well-known codes. Our method makes an invalid call in 3 3 of its 101 101 POST runs ( 0.03 0.03 , 95% CI [ 0.01 , 0.08 ] [0.01,0.08] ) and invents no code. Two of its three invalid calls put a header key ( ShippingCondition ) on a sales-order item, and one reads an entity set from the wrong service. Per query, our invalid-run rate is lower than ChunkRAG’s ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 56 n=56 ).

paragraphs.en: Symmetric baseline: ChunkRAG with inlined value-help. Plain ChunkRAG cannot see value-help lists. To separate “the value list was visible” from “a typed graph carried it”, we add a third condition that pastes the value-help code lists as plain text into ChunkRAG’s retrieved chunks. Everything else stays the same. Pasting the lists closes the code class: ChunkRAG+VH invents no codes in its 128 128 POST runs. Showing the value list is therefore enough to stop invented codes, whatever form it takes. It does not stop other invalid calls: 120 120 remain in 59 59 of the 128 128 POST runs ( 0.46 0.46 , 95% CI [ 0.38 , 0.55 ] [0.38,0.55] ), because flat text does not constrain the payload structure. With the full typed context, the rate falls to 0.03 0.03 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 per query against ChunkRAG+VH, n = 56 n=56 ).

paragraphs.en: The whole retrieval gain flows through the 45 45 hand-written USES_ENTITY_SET edges, so their authoring cost is the main practical bottleneck. Three properties keep it low. First, the effort grows with the number of business processes, not with the size of the catalogue: the 42 42 services, 132 132 EntitySets, and 8,481 8{,}481 properties were loaded with no manual work. Second, writing an edge only requires knowing which documents an activity reads or writes, which process owners already know; unlike OWL-S and WSMO annotations, it needs no ontology expertise. Third, the mapping is small enough to review in full.
paragraphs.zh: 整个检索增益都通过那 45 条手写的 USES_ENTITY_SET 边来传递，因此编写这些边的成本是主要的实际瓶颈。 三个特性使其保持在较低水平。 首先，工作量随业务流程的数量增长，而不是随目录的规模增长：42 个服务、132 个 EntitySet 和 8,481 个属性的加载无需任何人工操作。 其次，编写一条边只需要知道某个活动读取或写入了哪些文档，而流程负责人本来就了解这些信息；与 OWL-S 和 WSMO 注解不同，它不需要本体方面的专业知识。 第三，这个映射足够小，可以完整地审查一遍。

paragraphs.en: We measured this cost directly. One author familiar with the catalogue re-wrote a random sample of ten mapped activities, covering 12 12 of the 45 45 edges, from scratch under a timer, following a fixed four-step procedure (Supplementary Sec. S6). The sample took 205 205 person-minutes (median 20.5 20.5 minutes per activity, range 16 16 – 25 25 ), and every re-written edge matched the released mapping. At the median rate, all 41 41 mapped activities would take about 840 840 person-minutes, or about two working days of focused effort.

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. The evaluation has a known circularity. The mock validator checks keys and codes against the same schema and ValueHelp nodes from which we build the graph. paragraphs.en: External validity. The gain depends entirely on process edges, so it only transfers to ecosystems that publish a process layer, or where one can be written. paragraphs.en: To call APIs reliably over several steps, an LLM agent must respect sequential and parametric constraints: process order, required keys, and valid code values. We meet this need by combining OData $metadata and BPMN reference processes in one typed property graph. Hybrid retrieval combines dense embeddings with process-chain expansion, and a ReAct agent uses the resulting value-help and cardinality context to build payloads. On process-chain queries, the method improves Recall@3 by + 5.7 +5.7 points ( p = 0.037 p=0.037 , n = 74 n=74 ), and it stays close to dense retrieval elsewhere. The ablation shows that the gain comes from process edges, not from generic graph structure. In the execution probe, typed context stops invented codes and almost all invalid keys: our method makes an invalid call in 3 3 of its 101 101 POST runs, while the baseline does so in 100 100 of 127 127 , with 60 60 invented codes. On multi-step test queries, our agent also completes more tasks than the baseline ( 0.387 0.387 vs. 0.103 0.103 ), although completion remains low for both and the system is not yet ready for deployment. The evaluation is also partly circular, because the mock validator and the graph share the same metadata. Future work should test against an independent backend, go beyond SAP reference processes, automate the process layer, and improve seed coverage and the agent’s use of tools.

paragraphs.en: The first version of the benchmark had 80 80 queries labelled by one annotator. We grew it to its current size with a two-annotator protocol. First, we generated a pool of 251 251 candidate queries automatically from the catalogue and the process graph. Each candidate came with machine-suggested labels and a note on how it was derived. Two annotators then reviewed the full pool independently, following a written protocol. Annotator A was a human author. Annotator B was a large language model (Claude, Anthropic); we disclose this openly and release its scripted per-candidate decisions with the repository.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试的首个版本包含80 80条由一名标注者标注的查询。 我们通过双标注者协议将其扩充至目前的规模。 首先，我们从目录和流程图中自动生成了一个包含251 251条候选查询的池。 每条候选查询都附带机器建议的标签以及关于其生成方式的说明。 两名标注者随后按照书面协议独立审查了全部候选查询池。 标注者A是人类作者。 标注者B是一个大语言模型（Claude，Anthropic）；我们对此公开披露，并在代码库中发布其针对每条候选查询的脚本化决策。

paragraphs.en: Two scope notes matter. First, the SAP catalogue is available only as structured CSV exports from the SAP Business Accelerator Hub, not as raw XML, so the audit treats these exports as the source of record. For TripPin, Northwind, and Microsoft Graph, it checks the full path from XML to graph. Second, we compare ValueHelp lists with their hand-curated seed tables, because the ingested $metadata has no machine-readable value-list annotations. The mock validator uses the same seed tables. The audit does not cover the hand-written USES_ENTITY_SET edges, because no independent source exists for them. The main paper assesses them with a provenance split (RQ1).
paragraphs.zh: 有两个范围说明需要注意。 首先，SAP 目录仅能以结构化 CSV 导出的形式从 SAP Business Accelerator Hub 获取，而非原始 XML，因此审计将这些导出文件视为记录来源。 对于 TripPin、Northwind 和 Microsoft Graph，审计会检查从 XML 到图的完整路径。 其次，我们将 ValueHelp 列表与其人工整理的种子表进行比较，因为所摄取的 $metadata 不含机器可读的值列表注解。 模拟验证器使用相同的种子表。 审计不涵盖手写的 USES_ENTITY_SET 边，因为它们不存在独立的来源。 主论文通过来源划分（RQ1）对它们进行评估。

paragraphs.en: We also check whether each retrieved entity comes with all the context the agent needs. On the agent’s discovery path (top-5 seeds), the retrieved context is complete for 3/3 required payload keys, 1/1 value-help code lists, 75/85 navigation cardinalities on gold parent–child pairs, and 67/79 process dependencies. Almost all gaps come from retrieval. In 34 of the 35 failing pairs, at least one entity is missing from the discovery result. Either no dense seed lands in the gold cluster (the SalesOrder cluster in six queries, the Microsoft Graph users cluster in two), or the discovery tool reports process dependencies only for pairs next to a retrieved seed, so second-hop chain members are left out. In the single exception, both entities are retrieved, but their dependency is reported only relative to the dense seeds. Whenever both entities of a required pair are retrieved, keys and cardinality are complete. The gaps are retrieval failures, not failures in building the context.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还会检查每个检索到的实体是否带有智能体所需的全部上下文。 在智能体的发现路径（前 5 个种子）上，针对黄金父子对所检出的上下文覆盖了 3/3 的必需载荷键、1/1 的值帮助码表、85 个导航基数中的 75 个，以及 79 个流程依赖中的 67 个。 几乎所有的缺口都来自检索。 在 35 个失败对中的 34 个里，发现结果中至少缺失一个实体。 要么没有稠密种子落入黄金簇（六次查询中的 SalesOrder 簇、两次查询中的 Microsoft Graph 用户簇），要么发现工具只报告与检索到的种子相邻的配对的流程依赖，从而遗漏了第二跳链上的成员。 在唯一的例外中，两个实体都被检索到，但它们的依赖关系只是相对于稠密种子被报告的。 只要必需配对的两个实体都被检索到，键和基数就是完整的。 这些缺口是检索失败，而不是构建上下文时的失败。

paragraphs.en: On the subset, a wrong seed was the main risk. The offline retriever in RQ1 gets the benchmark query word for word, while the agent retrieves with its own rewording. If the rewording picks a wrong but similar-sounding EntitySet, process expansion adds the wrong chain, and the retrieve-then-execute design fails early. ChunkRAG shows flat endpoint text and may still reach a completing call. Process context therefore helps when the seed is right and makes things worse when it is wrong. On the subset, retrieval misses caused most failures for both methods: 40 40 of 55 55 ChunkRAG failures and 43 43 of 63 63 of ours. On the larger test set, which is mostly process-chain goals, ChunkRAG far more often makes no call at all, and this outweighs the wrong-seed risk.

paragraphs.en: We tried the direct fix for committing to a wrong seed too early. Inside the discovery tool, the same LLM checks the dense seeds against the user query, and only verified seeds start process-chain expansion. Unverified seeds are still shown as plain specifications. On the subset ( 78 78 runs), verification removes invalid writes completely ( 0 0 invalid POST calls, vs. 3 3 for the unverified agent and 9 9 for ChunkRAG). The cost is more invalid exploratory reads ( 11 11 GET probes to service/entity pairs that do not exist, which the mock rejects harmlessly). Completion improves only slightly ( 0.205 0.205 vs. 0.192 0.192 ; ChunkRAG 0.295 0.295 ). The conditional rates explain why. Completion is 0.421 0.421 when in-loop discovery returned all gold entities and 0.000 0.000 when it did not. Verification can reject a wrong seed but cannot add a missing one, and the main failure is a missing seed, not a wrong one. Closing the completion gap therefore needs better seed coverage (larger candidate pools, query rewriting), not stricter filtering.
paragraphs.zh: 我们尝试了针对过早提交到错误种子的直接修复方法。 在发现工具内部，同一个 LLM 将密集种子与用户查询进行核对，只有通过验证的种子才会启动过程链扩展。 未通过验证的种子仍以普通规格的形式显示。 在子集（78 78 次运行）上，验证完全消除了无效写入（0 0 次无效 POST 调用，而未验证的智能体为 3 3 次，ChunkRAG 为 9 9 次）。 代价是更多的无效探索性读取（11 11 次对不存在服务/实体对的 GET 探测，模拟环境会无害地拒绝这些探测）。 完成率仅略有提升（0.205 0.205 对 0.192 0.192；ChunkRAG 为 0.295 0.295）。 条件比率解释了原因。 当循环内发现返回了全部金标实体时，完成率为 0.421 0.421；否则为 0.000 0.000。 验证可以拒绝错误的种子，但无法补上缺失的种子，而主要失败原因正是种子缺失，而非种子错误。 因此，缩小完成率差距需要更好的种子覆盖（更大的候选池、查询改写），而不是更严格的过滤。

paragraphs.en: RQ3 mixes retrieval and execution failures. We therefore add an oracle condition in which the agent receives the gold specification for each query (perfect retrieval). Any remaining failure must then come from payload construction and tool use. We score required-key adherence, value-help adherence, correct nesting of 1:N navigations as arrays, and retries after the validator rejects a call, for both conditions under the same oracle context.
paragraphs.zh: RQ3 将检索失败与执行失败混在一起。 因此我们增加一个 oracle 条件，其中智能体为每个查询获得标准规范（完美检索）。 这样一来，剩余的失败必然来自载荷构建与工具使用。 在相同的 oracle 上下文下，我们针对两种条件对必选键符合度、取值帮助符合度、将 1:N 导航正确嵌套为数组，以及在校验器拒绝调用后的重试进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Under oracle retrieval ( 78 78 runs per condition, no timeouts), completion stays low for both agents (ours 0.256 0.256 , ChunkRAG 0.359 0.359 ). The completion gap on the subset is thus not only a retrieval effect. It also reflects execution limits of the 30B LLM, mainly failures to use the tools and incomplete payloads. Payload construction still separates the two conditions. With the same gold context, ChunkRAG issues 15 15 schema-invalid writes, including 6 6 invented codes, while ours issues 3 3 and invents none. Required-key adherence is low for both ( 0.25 0.25 vs. 0.08 0.08 ). Only the typed prompt leads to correct nesting of 1:N children as arrays ( 6 6 of 29 29 posting runs vs. 0 0 of 22 22 ). Retrying after a rejected call is rare in both conditions ( 2 2 vs. 0 0 runs). Looking only at runs where retrieval succeeded gives the same picture. Over the 35 35 runs whose discovery returned every gold entity, completion is 0.43 0.43 (ours) vs. 0.57 0.57 (ChunkRAG), against 0.00 0.00 vs. 0.07 0.07 when it did not. Good retrieval is necessary for completion, but execution remains the main bottleneck.

paragraphs.en: We use the non-primary LLMs only to check external validity. gemma4:31b runs once per query ( 26 26 runs per condition, no timeouts). On the subset, its results point the same way as the primary LLM: higher ChunkRAG completion, and zero invalid calls for both. qwen3.6 hit the latency ceiling in 92 % 92\% of ChunkRAG runs and 69 % 69\% of our runs, so its rows mainly measure serving instability rather than agent behaviour. Local LLM serving can stall across condition switches when its cache is reused on CPU-only serving; restarting the server between conditions avoids this. paragraphs.en: For each of the 14 14 processes, a local LLM ( qwen3-coder:30b ) receives the catalogue (services with their entity sets) and the ordered task activities, and proposes USES_ENTITY_SET edges.
